task.description: WF-03 Step 0.5 (registry lookup: docs/issues/*.yaml resolved entries about service tasks / request_build_error / seeding, e.g. ISS-0897, ISS-0893) + Step 1 (diagnose), combined. Defect D1 (BLOCKER): on QA (https://qa.bizdala.com) meridian/vortex definitions seeded by scripts/seed_meridian_definition.sh and scripts/seed_vortex_definition.sh (payload fixtures test/fixtures/simulation/meridian/process_claim_intake.yaml -> test/fixtures/qa/meridian_loan_origination_process_definition.json etc.) have service-task nodes (POST /kyc/screen at kyc-aml-check; /mes/.../quarantine at quarantine-batch; /mes/.../assign at assign-line) that fail with request_build_error (instances ERROR, error_detail service_task_retries_exhausted, last_failure_kind request_build_error). Find the ROOT CAUSE: read lib/letflow/engine/service_task.ex, the dispatcher/http transport (lib/letflow/engine/ service_task_dispatcher*, the :target_url_not_allowed / URL allow-list / base_url resolution path, design docs lib/letflow/design/service_task*.md) and the seeded node configs; determine which {:request_build_error, reason} reason is produced and why (e.g. relative path with no base URL, target_url_not_allowed allowlist, missing connector/service config). Decide whether the fix belongs in the seed definition (fixtures/seed scripts), the engine, or both. REPRODUCE: (a) locally by reproducing the seeded node config through the engine/transport in a test or mix run (b) on real QA read-only: get a token with `bash /c/Users/tvolo/dev/ai-dala/ai-dala-infra/scripts/qa-uat-env.sh token meridian-admin-user` (prints a BARE JWT; capture in a shell variable only; NEVER print it, never write it to any file or your handoff) and GET the definition JSON from https://qa.bizdala.com/api/v1/definitions to read the deployed service-task node config; you may ssh per qa-uat-env.sh if you need server-side config/env (e.g. allowed-hosts env vars) but never print secrets. Do not create test instances in this step unless essential (if you do, cancel them). Do NOT implement the fix. Work ONLY in the worktree given in context.worktree (never the main checkout C:/Users/tvolo/dev/ai-dala/letflow-4). Do not commit; ORCH commits. Fill result in this handoff file; set status IN_PROGRESS at claim, then COMPLETED/FAILED at end with result.status PASS/FAIL. result.summary must give root cause with line citations, the reason term observed, affected files, recommended fix location (seed vs engine vs both), and whether a real mix-test regression test is feasible (engine fix) or only a fixture/seed contract test (seed fix). Also list owned_modules the fix will write. next_action: 'Route to CODE-DESIGNER for fix design'.
